balls.text: full toss angling across and finishing wide of off. Driven to long-off, as Siraj has a fall!
now over deep midwicket! He pulls hard at this short-of-a-length ball on middle, getting his front leg out of the way to hammer this for six more
finally put away! Six over deep backward point, as Pooran slices at this full ball angling across and ending around seventh stump. He sent it racing for six more
bouncer at a change of pace, and that is three dots! Digs it in short on leg, with the ball rising and finishing over middle. Pooran looked to pull, but the ball went over him

another dot ball. Very similar to the last delivery. Full and wide of off, with Pooran aiming to go over the off side but missing. Pooran reviews for a potential wide again, but the third umpire observes that there is movement across by Pooran, and that the ball is close to the bat. So it remains
starts with a wide yorker, which he angles across and bowls in the channel. Pooran went swinging, but missed
this is another full toss, but this is low and dipping around sixth stump. Dragged to long-on, as he plays away from his body

ahh, Topley goes back to his yorker-length ball which is wide of off. Pitches it around sixth stump, with Pooran attempting to loft but missing. Wide not called, but LSG review. It stays the same, though
hits the roof over deep midwicket! This is thrashed down towards Cubbon Park. Topley went for a slower ball, changing his length to go short and outside off. Pooran pulled powerfully for a 106m six!
almost a repeat of the last ball! Another full toss outside off, which Pooran lets come to him before crashing it over deep point by opening the face of the bat again
bashed over deep point! Hit hard and flat, as Topley bowled a full toss in line with the stumps, swinging it in too. Pooran waited and sliced it away
this is a wide, though. He goes full and pretty wide outside off, with Pooran leaving it alone
ahh, this is close! Bowls a yorker bang close to the wide line, with Pooran letting it go

well taken by du Plessis! The ball was dropping over his right shoulder, as placed at extra cover, he tumbled across to his right while watching the ball well. Dayal went for a bouncer, angling it across, while also changing the pace. The ball rose rather sharply, and was very wide of off. Badoni still went swatting, but ended up getting it off the outside half of the bat
clubbed on the bounce to long-off, as he gets another slower ball, which is on the fullish side around off
yorker again, and wide of off. Pooran goes slashing, but gets a bottom edge running towards the off side. Dayal chases it, and Pooran goes back in his crease after attempting a run
ahh, change of pace, and Dayal escapes being hit! On a length on middle, as Pooran went hoicking to the leg side, but is hit on his body
slower ball, and on a length wide of off. The ball moves away, and is swatted back to the bowler
crushed to deep backward point! It was swinging away, and landed on a yorker length on sixth stump. Pooran stood deep in the crease, and opened the face of the bat to ram it away
full and quicker on middle and off, and hoicked off the inside half of the bat to midwicket
slower ball, and full on off. Clipped to midwicket

taken at long-off by Dagar again! A full toss outside off, as it dips on to the batter this time too. Topley went for the back-of-the-hand slower ball. De Kock went lofting back down the ground, but ended up giving a comfortable catch to long-off coming a few steps to his left

dropped by Rawat! He ended halfway between the pitch and where an imaginary square leg would have been, and kept his eyes on it all along, but the ball dropped off his gloves. Topley bowled a slower ball on a full length just outside off, as de Kock went to attack across the line but got it off the top half of the bat
a full toss which dips on to off stump around waist height. Swings to deep midwicket, and is sent back by Pooran for an attempted second
a dipping yorker on fifth stump, as Topley angles it in. De Kock loses his bottom hand in trying to swipe, but is beaten
gets his front leg out of the way at this full toss on middle and leg, and whips it to deep square
mid-off is up, and de Kock goes over him this time! He gets a length ball which is angling across and finishing wide of off, reaching out to loft with a slightly horizontal bat
again Siraj goes for the short ball on middle, getting it to angle away towards off. De Kock went to pull but was beaten
this time he beats mid-off! Du Plessis dives to his left, but is beaten. De Kock is again deep in the crease, and drills this full ball wide-ish of off
good bowling. He goes for a low, dipping full toss, which is nearly a yorker just outside off. Driven to mid-off from deep in the crease
a bouncer on middle, with the ball finishing around fifth stump. Dabbed to short third, as he rides the bounce
superb bowling! He follows a bouncer with a yorker, swinging it away and going wide of off. De Kock went reaching for it, but missed

a half-hearted shout for caught behind by Rawat, but it is instead called wide. They have a chat... and du Plessis reviews. Bouncer on off, with the ball seaming back in to finish on leg. There is good bounce, with de Kock looking to pull and the ball going over his bat. Multiple replays are checked, and the third umpire confirms it is not a wide. The ball went just over the gloves there, with the not-out decision standing
yorker again, as Dayal keeps going wide of off. Guided to deep third, as he opens the face of the bat
again goes for a yorker-length ball, which is wide of off. De Kock runs it down deep point while playing away from his body
ahh, nice change of pace from Dayal, who goes full and wide of off. De Kock went hacking, but missed for another dot
yorker length, and wide of off. De Kock shaped to slash, but left it alone
full ball dipping on off, and blocked towards cover

taken by Dagar! He was placed at point, and saw the ball come on to his right, as he moved a few steps and grabbed with both hands. Maxwell strikes again, as he bowls short and wide of off. Stoinis had backed away early, so the line of the ball meant that it was quite wide of him. He eventually reached out for it, and ended up swatting to the fielder
shorter in length, and outside off. Swiped behind square for a single
slower, and fuller on middle and leg. Defended back to the bowler
quicker, and on a length on off. Turns in, and is punched to long-off
heaved over deep midwicket! That is massive hit! The full ball on the stumps dips on to the batter, with Stoinis heaving it powerfully for a huge hit
lofted wide of long-off! De Kock in punishing mood now. He squats a little, and reaches out at this length ball which is wide of off. Presents the full face of the bat to lift it over mid-off
on a length just outside off, and coming into the stumps. Pushed towards cover for a quick single
hammered over deep square leg! Another full toss from Green, as this one lands just below his waist on the stumps. Swung away for six more, this time by Stoinis
quite full and just outside off, and driven to long-on
the ball flies over the deep-point boundary! He lets this low full toss arrive outside off - the ball was dipping - as he sliced this from deep in the crease. Looked very good
full toss swinging into off, and driven wide of mid-off
six just over the rope! Again de Kock goes over the bowler's head, with Dagar bowling full and just outside off, and de Kock allowing himself to get on top of the ball by hanging back
full and wide of off, and left alone. Wide not called
belted back down the ground! That is also de Kock's fifty. He hangs deep in the crease at this length ball, which is flat and just outside off, before ramming it back between long-off and long-on
ahh, slows it down to bowl full on his pads. Tickled to short fine, as de Kock calls for the single
length ball on the stumps, and pushed back
on the bounce to long-off running forward! De Kock made room and went lofting this fullish ball angling across and finishing outside off
drills this full ball angling away towards off, and gets a single wide of mid-off
another one that goes past his bat! This time he went swinging at this length ball angling away and landing a bit wide of off, but didn't connect
gets across, and looks to slash this fullish ball wide of off, which is angled across. But he's beaten again, as de Kock loses his momentum after a rapid start
gets across, and flicked to fine leg! He exposed all his stumps to this full ball just outside off, and clipped it with his front leg in the air to Siraj's right
good bounce from a length just outside off, with the ball finishing on top of middle. Pushed towards cover
angles this in, and bowls a low full toss on leg. Flicked to fine leg, as Stoinis sits deep in the crease to whip it away wide of the fielder
full ball on middle and off, and driven to long-off
length ball on the stumps, and clipped to deep square leg
full and flat on off, and driven off the inside half of the bat to long-on
ahh, well stopped by Karthik at point! He dived to his left to keep it to one, with de Kock slashing at this length ball wide of off
full and dipping on off. Driven wide of long-off
on a length just outside off, and slapped to deep point
starts with five wides! Full ball another set of stumps outside leg, with de Kock going to sweep but missing. Even the keeper beaten while moving to his right
short of a length again. This is outside off and coming on top of the stumps. Blocked back by Stoinis

taken by Rawat running back! He turned around and started chasing the ball, going down on his haunches to take the ball which was dropping over his head, taking it just over his face. Rawat didn't get distracted by deep third running forward either. Siraj went for a back-of-a-length ball this time, landing it on leg. Padikkal cleared his front leg, and went for the pull, but only managed to get a top edge
the third wide of the over. Siraj went for a bouncer on leg, with the ball moving away sharply to finish outside off. Padikkal let it go, with the ball dying on to the batter
a full toss dipping and landing outside leg, as he looked to clip but missed. Another wide
ahh, this is too high, and hence called wide! The keeper had to leap full stretch to take that, with Padikkal swaying away at this bouncer on middle
low full angling across, and finishing around sixth stump. He goes low to slice it to deep third
clubbed over long-on! On a length on middle, and this one moves away again, but de Kock is deep in the crease, with his front leg out of the way. Big six for him
uff, nice pace and bounce! On the shorter side of a length on middle, and angling away, as de Kock looked to ramp but missed, with the ball rushing over his bat
short of a length on leg and moving away, and clipped to deep square leg
slows it down, as de Kock looks to nudge but is beaten. Maxwell appeals for lbw, but it's turned down. That seemed to be heading down the leg side too, with de Kock playing it from middle and leg
ahh, this hurries on to him and goes on with the angle on to the stumps off a length. Punched to point
fullish ball on middle and leg, and he goes deep in the crease to whip behind square
he goes sweeping at this full ball angled into leg, but gets an inside edge on to his pad
on a length around fifth stump, with a hint of turn away. Clipped wide of long-on from deep in the crease
slow, and full on middle and off. Driven to long-off
change of pace, and on a length slightly wide of off. He waits for it to come, before tickling it to deep third
ahh, good pace and bounce! He went on a length just outside off while angling it in at 137kph, with Padikkal getting squared up and beaten on the outside edge
slower ball, and short of a length on fifth stump. Pulled forcefully to deep square leg
length ball outside off. Went slogging again, but was beaten

ohh, tough catch dropped by Maxwell! He was back-pedalling, with his eyes on the ball, and the ball dropping beside his right shoulder. He went with his right hand only, although I felt he could have used both hands. De Kock went lofting at this fullish ball just outside off, but didn't time it
guides this fullish ball just outside off to deep third, as he stands on leg stump to Topley
on the bounce to Dagar at fine leg! He moved to his left to try and cover some ground, but the ball still fell well short, as Padikkal went sweeping at this full ball angled into his pads
quicker, and on a fullish length on off. Again turns away a bit, and is punched to point
dips this fullish ball on middle and off, which turns away a bit. Pushed towards point, and sent back by de Kock

taken at extra cover! Dagar keeps his eyes on the ball, which Rahul sent ballooning off outside half of the bat, and took it in front of his chest. Maxwell pulled his length back to go short and slightly wide of off. Rahul was in the mood for more, and got his front leg out of the way in trying to swat it away. But there was good bounce for the bowler, and the ball skied up for a catch

six despite Patidar getting a hand! He was at fine leg, and threw himself to his right. He leapt well too, but the ball dropped off his right hand. Rahul went sweeping at this full ball angled into middle, and absolutely thumped it
length ball on off, and quicker. Clipped to square leg

gets across, and escapes getting out, with the ball coming from nowhere near the middle of the bat. He went lofting at this fullish ball wide of off which was angled in, and sent it over the bowler's head. Maxwell chased it and pulled the ball back last moment, as the batters ran two
the shot of the day! This looked very elegant, as he launched this full ball around fifth stump. It was angled in, and Rahul went over the bowler's head with the full face of the bat

gets the toe end of the bat towards point! Dayal takes pace off and goes slower bouncer at 108kph only. The ball pitches just outside off and climbs on considerably, with de Kock's attempted pull not finding any timing
attempts to loft, but is beaten. This is angled in on a full length around seventh stump, and moves away as de Kock is beaten again
ahh, de Kock shaped to scoop, but saw the ball being on a length, and wide of off. He then switched to try and guide it towards deep third, but was beaten
on a length on middle, and angling across. Punched to mid-off's right to keep ticking
on a length on middle and off, and clipped to square leg. Rahul sends de Kock back after an attempted single
goes deep in the crease, and clips this length ball on middle and off to deep square leg
steps out, and ends up tucking this fullish ball on leg to mid-on
he backs away early, and Maxwell goes on a full length on middle. Turns in to end outside leg, and is pushed to cover
slows it down, and bowls full on off. Pushed wide of mid-off for a single
nudges this length ball on the stumps wide of mid-on for a quick single
bowls on a shortish length on middle, and the turn takes it down the leg side, as Rahul misses his attempted clip. Wide called
ahh, nice comeback by Siraj! Fires in a yorker on fifth stump, and de Kock gets his bat down to jam it back towards the bowler
over deep backward square leg! Siraj goes on a length again, although this one is on middle and leg. De Kock is deep in the crease, and gets his front leg out of the way to dispatch the ball
into the first tier! A pick-up shot, typical of de Kock. He lets this length ball on his pads arrive, before swinging through the line to hit over fine leg
leading edge... but falls well short of mid-off! He looked to clip but seemed to have closed the face of the bat too early, with this length ball landing on leg and moving away a bit
there is a man at deep backward point, as Rahul drives at this length ball angling in but moving away after landing in the channel outside off
ahh, beats Rahul first ball! Bowls full and wide of off, angling it in though the ball moves away after pitching, with Rahul driving far away from his body
angles this in, and bowls on a length just outside off as the ball swings in to finish on middle. Clipped to fine leg
misfield by the man behind point, as he tumbles to his left. There is a fielder at deep point, though, and he chases to his right, after de Kock slashes at this length ball wide of off
ohh, some extra bounce off a fullish length in the corridor. De Kock shouldered arms this time, and the ball zoomed up into the keeper's gloves
driven to deep point! More width for de Kock, as he spots this away swinging ball landing on a full length on sixth stump, and goes low to drive between point and extra cover
tickles this length ball on leg, which ends around middle after shaping away. Single to fine leg

uff, superb effort by Kohli! He has saved a potential four there, as he dives full stretch to his left from over. Fullish ball angling across from Dayal and finishing just outside off, as Rahul drove with the full face of the bat
punched to deep backward point! Again Topley bowled wide, although this was on the shorter side of a length. De Kock waited before pressing from deep in the crease to beat deep third to his left
flung away over cover-point! This is a fullish delivery in the channel outside off, as de Kock squats a little to loft that by slightly opening the face of the bat
another short delivery, and some good bounce again. This is pitched around sixth stump, as de Kock looks to pull but is beaten
ahh, top edge flies over slip! Falls just short of the rope for a four. De Kock was beaten by the bounce there, with his bottom hand coming off as he shaped to pull at this shortish ball on off
now de Kock goes driving far away from his body, but is beaten. This was on a length, and wide of off, with the ball angled in and straightening away
on the fuller side of a length just outside off, with the ball angled in from over the wicket. Tapped towards cover-point

Oh, Nicholas Pooran you beauty! Siraj lofts Naveen straight down the ground, Pooran runs across from long-on and throws himself at it and holds on tumbling forward. And LSG have bowled RCB out to register a 28-run win!
Short and angled into Siraj, who was backing away and looking to ramp
Naveen goes wide as Siraj swings for the hills, and misses
Full and angling into off, pushed towards cover for a single
Back-to-back sixes! This is tossed up wide and Siraj slogs it down the ground. Into the sightscreen!
Oh, my days! Siraj takes a step out and thrashes a slot ball over long-off and into the stands!

And Bishnoi wraps it up! Although, Siraj has reviewed. He is trapped in front by a googly. Hit on the knee roll of the front pad. Siraj has a laugh with Deepak Hooda as they wait on ball tracking. After a long wait, we have ball tracking. And oh! That's going over leg stump! Siraj survives. Two successful reviews for RCB on a day not much else has been successful for them
Wrong'un on a length goes down leg
Tossed up outside off, Siraj parries towards point
On a length outside off, chopped out to deep point
On a length around off, blocked back to the bowler's right
Wafts at a back of length delivery outside off and is beaten
That should be game, set and match. Full outside off, he looks to go over long-off, but hits it too flat and Nicholas Pooran makes absolutely no mistake. Lomror's counterattack ends
Length ball around off, he taps it towards cover this time and this time they do get a quick single, with a throw at the striker's end missing the stumps
Pace off length ball outside off, Topley taps it towards backward point and wants the quick single but Krunal Pandya is sharp to react and they deny RCB the single
Back of length outside off, Topley can't connect as he looks to dab it on the off side

Goes high in the air, but lands in no man's land. But wait, there's a run-out! Lomror takes a full ball and skies it short of long-on. Pooran runs in gets the ball and was looking to throw it to the keeper but ends up hitting the stumps at the striker's end where Dagar is caught well short as he looked to go for a second but was sent back
On a length outside off, Dagar can't connect as he looks to slap it away
Gloved behind! That's that for DK. It's a back of length delivery angled into Karthik who wants to pull, but gets cramped for room and it pops up to Rahul
Full and slides down leg

Full going across him, pitches outside leg and hits him on the back thigh as he gets down to slog. The ball goes past off stump and they race a single with Karthik just making it in time as the throw is on target at the striker's end

Oh, that is just so smartly played! Naveen takes the pace off and bowls a short ball across him. Lomror was set up for the pull but adjusts to just ramp it over the keeper for four. Excellent smarts showed by Lomror
Lomror hits a massive six over long-on! Into the second tier! This is on a length outside off and Lomror gets all of that and then some!
Length ball outside off, eased to deep backward point
Slaps a length ball outside off to cover for a quick single
Full on middle and off and now Lomror flicks it out to deep midwicket on the bounce

Hoicked wide of long-on now! Is there life in this game still? Takes on a length ball and swings it to the left of Nicholas Pooran running across from long-on. Didn't middle it but gets enough to go the distance
Slashed wide of the keeper for four! This is short outside off, Lomror leans back and looks to play the upper cut. Gets an edge there but there is no slip fielder
Crrreaaammmed over long-off! This is full outside off and Lomror clears his front leg and muscles it into the ad boards!
Length ball around off, Karthik drops it square on the leg side

Back of length outside off, Karthik punches it out to deep point for a single. An electric, exhilerating spell from Mayank Yadav comes to an end. Four wickets fell off his four overs, including a run out which was more thanks to Padikkal than anything else, and only 14 runs conceded

Mayank Yadav has his fourth! He traps Karthik! But DK reviews. It angles in from outside off to rap him on the front pad. Could this be going high? This was bowled at around 147kph, btw. Okay, no wicket no. 4 for Mayank yet. That's shown to be going above the stumps so Karthik survives
Back of length delivery angling down leg, Karthik nudges it down square on the leg side. This one was at 147kph
Length ball outside off at 149.3kph, Karthik leaves it well alone

Top edge goes high in the air. Devdutt Padikkal makes no mistake at deep square leg! It's banged in short, Patidar goes for the pull and skies it. Devdutt Padikkal had to move around to settle under it, but never took his eyes off it and ends up grabbing it to send Patidar back in the hut. Mayank has his third!
Length ball outside off, 144.3kph, punched to backward point
Full around off,flicked away through midwicket

All sorts of confusion there! This is full around leg and Lomror misses his flick. Thakur goes up in appeal for lbw as the ball pops towards backward point. Hooda, the fielder, runs in and misses his throw as Lomror had taken off for a single and was being sent off. The over throw lets them get a run
Bowls a back of length delivery outside off that jags in, Patidar cuts to cover
Full around off and going across him, 139.1kph, Lomror guides it to deep third

Slapped away behind point! Short outside off, enough width for him to free his arms and hit it flat. They have to check if it's a boundary or a six. Did it hit the boundary rope on the full? Nope, four given
Full around off, miscued through midwicket
Stoinis angles a back of length delivery from outside off, Lomror is beaten on the cut

Rawat falls. Stoinis goes short around off as he sees Rawat advancing. Gets cramped for room and gets it off high on the bat to mid-on. Pooran has to take a few steps forward before grabbing it. Rawat has struggled today and gets out without much impact in the end
Now Stoinis fires a bouncer over Rawat, and KL Rahul, as it goes for five wides
Smartly played, but he doesn't get a boundary. It's a short ball angling into Rawat, who ramps it late over backward point. But deep third, Mayank Yadav, does well
Short of good length outside off, Rawat looks to slap it down the ground but can't beat mid-off
Length ball from outside off angles in, Patidar brings his bat down and gets an inside edge through backward square
Starts with a length ball outside off that Rawat drives to deep point
Full outside off and Patidar this time slaps it straight down the ground to beat long-on for four more
Patidar taking us back to that knock against LSG with this shot! In the arc and he swings it high over cow corner
Krunal drops a sitter at deep midwicket! This is a bit short and Rawat rocks back and pulls it flat, but the ball bobbles out of Krunal's hands!
Hits this to midwicket for a single
Full on middle and leg, swept to deep square leg
Full around off, goes across Rawat who leaves
Full outside off, Rawat steers to backward point and takes off for a quick single but is turned back.The fielder has a shy at the stumps, but misses and the overthrow lets RCB get the run
Length ball around off, punched out to sweeper cover
Swung over deep backward square! This is a length ball on middle and he flicks it off his hips, using the pace of the ball and helping it on fine on the leg side
Length ball angled across him, Rawat slaps it down to mid-off for a quick run
Back of length on off and seaming away. Rawat chases after it but can't connect. They contemplate reviewing it for wide but decide against it
Back of length around leg bounces sharply. Rawat wants to ramp it fine on the off side but it pings off his gloves and drops short of point
Back of length around off, Patidar guides it to backward point
Bouncer outside off, Patidar sways out of the way
Gets some width and cuts it to deep backward point
Rawat looks to ramp another short ball down leg, but can't connect. This was a slower one for Mayank, I suppose, at 145kph
Full on middle and leg, clipped through square leg and they get two. This was at 155.3kph!
Dug in short at 153kph around leg, Rawat looks to go across and scoop it, but misses
Full outside off, Patidar blocks
On a length from wide of the crease, goes past the outside edge as Patidar offers his bat in defence
Full on leg, Rawat nudges it away to long leg
Length ball angling across him, Rawat leaves
Just past the outside edge! Another length ball angling across him leaves Rawat beaten
On a length around leg, going across him, Rawat steers it to backward point
Back of length delivery hurries Rawat who wants to block but the ball goes off the leading edge towards point. Rawat gets off the mark
Full around middle and off, Rawat defends

What a corker! Length ball outside off, straightens ever so little and Green is beaten for pace on the outside edge as the ball rams into the off stump before racing away to the boundary! Mayank Yadav is turning on the heat!
Pulled just over mid-on with his arm stuck high in the air! Full outside off and Green swings it away. Doesn't middle it but gets enough to clear Pooran
Back of length delivery goes over the bat as Green looks to steer it fine on the off side
Mayank Yadav angles in a length ball from outside off, steered to backward point
Full on off, flicked out to deep midwicket
Length ball around off, blocked back to Bishnoi
Length ball clipped through midwicket for a single
Wrong'un on a length outside off, Patidar looks to tuck it leg-side but misses
Tossed up full on middle, Green whips it away to deep square leg
Drags a length ball down leg side
Tossed up full around off, Green leans ahead and chips it past the non-striker for a couple
Clipped away through midwicket! This was very full and very straight, Patidar nudges it past the diving fielder for his first boundary. This one was at 153kph!
Very full just outside off, Green jams his bat down to steer it past the slip fielder

Mayank Yadav has Maxwell! Pace does the trick. 151kph. Dug in on a length and Maxwell looks to swing it away. Slices it off the top edge. Pooran runs in from mid-on and pockets it. That's KGF back in the hut!
Bouncer outside off at 145.5kph, Maxwell lets it go by
Length ball at 144.2kph outside off, steers it past backward point for a single

Direct hit! Faf clips a full ball at 153.2kph towards midwicket and takes off. Padikkal is quick to pick up the ball and with one stump to aim at, absolutely nails it with du Plessis caught well short of the crease
Length ball outside off, du Plessis slaps it straight of cover on the bounce and finishes the over with a single
On a length on middle, du Plessis parries towards cover
Full on leg, tucked through midwicket and he gets off the mark
Length ball outside off, Patidar punches it to cover point

Siddharth has his man! Kohli skies it to backward point! Full outside off, Kohli was coming down the crowd and going for the big shot. He just gets a leading edge and the ball loops to backward point's left. Padikkal makes no mistake and Siddharth is pumped as the Chinnaswamy goes silent
Dropped short around off and Kohli cracks a cut in front of point. Picks the gap expertly and the ball races away
Chipped over mid-on! In the slot around off and du Plessis just stands and lofts it down the ground
du Plessis gets rushed by a 139kph delivery angling in from outside off. That swung in a bit as du Plessis looked to work it leg-side, He misses and the ball pops back towards the bowler
Low full toss outside off but Kohli misses out! Can only whip it to midwicket
Lofted straight into the sightscreen! Length ball at 139kph angles in from outside off, Kohli just takes a step forward and drives it straigh back down the ground. Pure class
Pitched up outside off at 133kph, Kohli spanks a drive on the off side but hits it straight to mid-off now
Full outside off and angling in, Kohli steps ahead and across and whips it to mid-on
